2026-10-31: a second form of the same stale red on PR heads. The pull_request_target gate run for a new head waits for a runner and is cancelled when a later oracle-gate run enters the same concurrency group (oracle-gate.yml:30-32, cancel-in-progress for non-push events); the cancelled gate check stays on the PR head and gh pr checks lists it as fail. Seen on #3840 (run 41149988156), #3844 (41151328389) and #3843 (41201677614), each after 29-41 minutes queued; all three had a green App-posted oracle-gate status and merged. Of the latest 300 oracle-gate runs, the 98 pull_request_target runs were 61 cancelled, 24 failed waiting for a verdict (exit 3) and 13 still running. Two delegated workers reported these as real gate failures.
description: The oracle-gate workflow's gate job fails with 'waiting for the oracle's verdict on <sha> ... rerun this check after it lands' when it starts before the verdict exists. After the verdict landed, make pr-rerun answered 'CI run <id> on <sha> succeeded; nothing to re-run' and the failed gate stayed red until the run was re-run by hand with gh run rerun <run> --failed. The gate then passed.
